title: Argentinian Beef Empanada Pie
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, this pie combines rich beef with a crumbly crust, inspired by Indian flavors.
instructions: In a pan, heat the ghee over medium heat.
Add the onion and ginger and cook until softened.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place a spoonful of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges with water and fold the dough over the filling.
Use a fork to crimp the edges and create a decorative border.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with egg wash and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite chutney or raita.
